mapper.select: SELECT a.id, a.title, a.content, a.category, a.tags, a.view_count, a.like_count, a.status, a.hidden, a.create_time, a.update_time, u.id AS author_id, u.nickname AS author_nickname, u.avatar AS author_avatar FROM article a LEFT JOIN user u ON u.id = a.author_id AND u.deleted = 0 WHERE a.deleted = 0 AND a.id = #{id}

SELECT a.id, a.title, a.content, a.author_id, a.category, a.tags, a.view_count, a.like_count, a.status, a.hidden, a.create_time, a.update_time FROM article a WHERE a.deleted = 0 AND a.status = 1 AND a.hidden = 0 AND (MATCH(a.title, a.content) AGAINST(#{keyword} IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) OR a.tags LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ESCAPE '!') ORDER BY MATCH(a.title, a.content) AGAINST(#{keyword} IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) DESC, a.create_time DESC

SELECT a.id, a.title, a.content, a.author_id, a.category, a.tags, a.view_count, a.like_count, a.status, a.hidden, a.create_time, a.update_time FROM article a WHERE a.deleted = 0 AND a.status = 1 AND a.hidden = 0 AND (a.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ESCAPE '!' OR a.content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ESCAPE '!' OR a.tags LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ESCAPE '!') ORDER BY a.create_time DESC

SELECT a.id AS article_id, (a.view_count * #{viewWeight} + a.like_count * #{likeWeight} + COALESCE(cm.cnt, 0) * #{commentWeight} + COALESCE(fv.cnt, 0) * #{favoriteWeight}) AS score FROM article a LEFT JOIN (SELECT article_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM comment WHERE deleted = 0 GROUP BY article_id) cm ON cm.article_id = a.id LEFT JOIN (SELECT article_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM favorite GROUP BY article_id) fv ON fv.article_id = a.id WHERE a.deleted = 0 AND a.status = 1 AND a.hidden = 0 AND a.create_time >= #{since} ORDER BY score DESC, a.create_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}
